claim: Driving vs. pumping: modulate a coefficient at twice the natural frequency and amplitude grows exponentially past a sharp threshold — 'silence, then a crack into self-oscillation' — and pumping at the wrong phase brakes instead of builds.

pieces.what: A swing you pump by squatting and standing; pump at 2 omega0 and it climbs, pump at omega0 or off-phase and it doesn't. Opens on the swing alone, then length changing, then the factor of 2
pieces.walks_up_from: one swing at its natural frequency

pieces.what: A Mathieu resonator you hear: sweep pump depth epsilon through epsilon_c and the decay turns into a crack into self-oscillation; a driven resonator under the same sweep 'warms up' for contrast. This is the page's own open psychoacoustic question
Pump phase rotates the Floquet modes; start on the decaying mode and watch it decay briefly inside an unstable tongue until noise leaks it onto the growing one
Additive vs multiplicative: the same oscillator, the input moved from the right-hand side into the coefficient
